scenes.description: Luna sits across from a shadowed figure. High contrast, cinematic lighting.
scenes.dialogue: My father owed the Blackmanes everything. His business. His house. His dignity. Get close to Roman Blackmane. Make him trust you. Then... help us take what's ours. And my father's debt? Erased. Every penny.

scenes.description: Luna stares at the contract, then picks up the pen and signs it.
scenes.dialogue: I told myself it was just a job. I didn't know he would change everything.
